title: Beautiful Chocolate-Colored Waechtersbach Mugs Are "Made in China"
text:
Beautiful Chocolate-Colored Waechtersbach Mugs Are "Made in China". These WAECHTERSBACH FUN FACTORY mugs are a gorgeous deep chocolate color. They're the same comfortable size and shape as the classic Waechtersbach mugs that I love for morning coffee. However, they're just a little bit heavier when empty, so I don't like them nearly as well as my classic ones.

When turned upside down, these mugs say, in tiny type in a glazed imprint, "Fun Factory by Waechtersbach Germany". They also display a little gold sticker that says "Made in China". (The classic mugs say, in raised unglazed letters, either "Waechtersbach . . . Made in Germany" or "Waechtersbach . . . Made in Spain".)

Like the classic mugs, these chocolate-colored mugs are not microwave safe but are dishwasher safe. Because these mugs are noticeably heavier than the classic Waechtersbach mugs, I rate them at 3 stars ("It's OK" on the official Amazon scale).
